photos.caption: The Hungarian Parliament reflected in the Danube.

photos.alt: Two glasses of beer and peanut shells on a wooden pub table.
Coffee and a hot dish in a small pan on a café table.
A stew in a bread bowl beside another plate of food and glasses of white wine.
The dome of the Hungarian Parliament lit gold at night, seen from close by.
A lit church spire and hilltop buildings across the river at night.
Bronze shoes on the stone edge of the Danube, one holding a red rose.
An orange sunrise over a bridge, reflected in the river.
A red door covered in stickers beside graffitied walls and a toilet sign.
A red beer and a lager in Dreher glasses on an outdoor table.
Hungarian flags with a hole in the centre flying against a pale sky.
A view down over Budapest's rooftops and a street along the river.
The Chain Bridge over the Danube, framed by autumn trees.
Two glasses of white wine clinking together.
A pale cocktail and a red drink with a rosemary sprig on a wooden table, beside a candle.
The Hungarian Parliament lit gold at night under a bright moon, reflected in the river.
Two lángos, one with salad and one with bacon and cheese, beside a beer and an orange drink.
Sunlight sparkling on rippling water.
A fountain on a pond at sunset, with trees and a stone bridge behind it.
Two domed towers of an ornate yellow building against a clear sky.
A grilled steak on sliced potatoes with a small pan of sauce.
